name: Sales & Marketing — Industrial Products and Services
description: Help manufacturing businesses understand how FEINCORE’s industrial automation products and engineering services can address their operational needs. This role combines customer discovery, solution coordination, sales follow-up, and clear technical marketing.
imageAlt: Sales and marketing professional discussing an industrial automation inspection station with a manufacturing team
responsibilities: Identify and engage manufacturing businesses that may benefit from automation, machine vision, robotics, modernization, and industrial software.
Understand customer requirements and coordinate with the engineering team to shape suitable product and service proposals.
Prepare presentations, quotations, product information, and follow-up plans for prospective customers.
Support practical marketing campaigns, customer case material, demonstrations, and industry outreach.
Maintain clear records of leads, conversations, opportunities, and customer feedback.
requiredSkills: Clear written and verbal communication with a customer-focused approach.
Interest in manufacturing, industrial technology, automation, or engineering services.
Ability to organize follow-ups, prepare professional presentations, and work across teams.
Comfort with digital marketing and common productivity tools; relevant sales or marketing experience is an advantage.
